input.headline: Invoice 4471 disputed; Dana awaiting a revised PO before paying
input.summary: Dana at Northwind flagged that invoice 4471 bills 14 licences against a PO for 12. Sam agreed the PO is the correct figure and said a revised invoice would follow. Dana will hold payment until it arrives, and the 30-day term restarts from the revised invoice date.
keyPoints: Invoice 4471 bills 14 licences; PO NW-2291 covers 12.
Sam accepted the PO figure as correct.
Payment is on hold pending a revised invoice.
Net-30 restarts from the revised invoice date.

actionItems.text: Issue a revised invoice for 12 licences
Release payment once the revised invoice arrives
